message.content:
Based on the screenshot of the data-recovery app:

(1) The scan progress gauge/indicator cluster is at the **BOTTOM** of the window.

(2) The elements in the bottom bar (from left to right) are:
*   **Status/Results summary:** "Results so far 9K files · 9 KB"
*   **Action buttons (Right-aligned):** "Save this search" and "Recover all..."
*   **Progress Cluster:** A circular progress spinner, "Overall progress: 0.3%", file/data found stats, and scan speed/time remaining.
*   **Control buttons (Far right):** "Pause" and "Stop".

(3) At the top of the content area sits a **toolbar** containing navigation buttons (Home, Back, Refresh), a location breadcrumb ("By location > 9K files"), view toggle icons (List/Grid), a "Filter" button, and a "Search by name" field. Above this toolbar is the blue progress/status bar indicating the current scan stage ("scan_stage.volume-analysis 0.3%").

(4) The left tree pane shows a hierarchical file structure under the main branch **"Existing files"** (displaying a total of 180K items). The sub-branches (folders) listed include: Temp, February, Media, office, Data, client, vacation, Work, birthday, 2024年项项..., August, Camera, and Archive. There are also two view tabs at the very top of this pane: **"By location"** (currently active) and **"By type"**.
